title: Factorial of a Number
statement: Calculate the factorial of a given integer N.
inputOutputContract: Input non-negative N (0..20); output N! using 64-bit arithmetic.

mistakes.hint1: Inspect the initializes factorial to zero behavior in factorial; the current algorithm is close, but one operation changes its result.
mistakes.hint2: Start by tracing T1 manually. Watch array indices / comparisons / loop boundaries / return values at each iteration or recursive return.
mistakes.hint3: Check the invariant of factorial: Start the factorial accumulator at one and multiply all factors from 2 through n.
mistakes.hint4: Concentrate on the expression or branch that controls this mistake: `long long result = 0;`. What does it do on the failing input?
mistakes.hint5: Compare the intermediate state with the expected output of T1. The mistake is in initializes factorial to zero, not merely formatting.
mistakes.hint6: Adjust the faulty operation so that it follows this rule: Start the factorial accumulator at one and multiply all factors from 2 through n.
mistakes.hint7: A targeted correction is to replace `long long result = 0;` with `long long result = 1;` in factorial, then retest T1–T6.
